understanding: The task requires relocating the 'action-evidence DONE-guard' code block from driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 (lines 12-95) to driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1, placing it immediately after the status-parse section (after line 1027), within the DONE∧normal-guard cluster, and before the done-gate (before line 1433). This relocation must eliminate two specific error metrics: 'property/variable not found' errors (currently 6 per session) and spurious 'DONE отклонён'/force_coder triggers after an accepted DONE. The deployment is high-risk because it modifies control-plane files (85 and 86), requiring a bridge_self_canary process with operator authorization, execution of driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1, and preparation of rollback notes. The guard must continue triggering on every driver turn.
summary: Relocate the action-evidence DONE-guard from 85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 to 86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 at the specified insertion point, validate through canary deployment with self-tests and smoke tests, obtain operator authorization, and document rollback procedures. This eliminates variable-not-found errors by ensuring the guard executes after status parsing where all required properties are available, and prevents spurious DONE rejections by placing the guard in the correct logical sequence before the done-gate.

decision_atoms.statement: Extract lines 12-95 from driver/85-loop-mode-transitions.ps1 as the action-evidence DONE-guard block
decision_atoms.reason: The task explicitly identifies this range as containing the guard logic that needs relocation
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Removing this block from 85 may temporarily break loop-mode-transitions until the new integration is validated, but the canary process mitigates this

decision_atoms.statement: Insert the extracted guard block into driver/86-loop-completion-checks.ps1 immediately after the status-parse section (after line 1027) and before the done-gate (before line 1433)
decision_atoms.reason: This placement ensures all status properties are parsed and available before the guard executes, eliminating 'property/variable not found' errors
decision_atoms.tradeoff: The insertion point must be precisely located; misplacement could disrupt the DONE∧normal-guard cluster logic or bypass the done-gate

decision_atoms.statement: Execute driver.ps1 -SelfTest and smoke.ps1 as part of canary validation
decision_atoms.reason: These tests verify the relocated guard functions correctly and no regressions occur in the driver's self-diagnostic and smoke test suites
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Test execution adds time to the deployment cycle but is essential for high-risk control-plane changes

decision_atoms.statement: Require operator authorization before production deployment
decision_atoms.reason: The task constraints mandate operator authorization for this control-plane edit due to high risk
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Adds a manual approval step that could delay deployment but ensures human oversight for safety-critical changes

decision_atoms.statement: Prepare comprehensive rollback notes documenting the exact steps to revert the guard relocation
decision_atoms.reason: If the canary reveals issues or production metrics degrade, the team must be able to quickly restore the original configuration
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Documentation effort is upfront but saves critical time during incident response

risks.risk: Incorrect line identification leads to inserting the guard at the wrong location in file 86
risks.mitigation: Verify line numbers and surrounding context (status-parse end, done-gate start) through code review before making changes; use diff tools to confirm insertion point

risks.risk: The extracted guard block has implicit dependencies on variables or functions only available in file 85's scope
risks.mitigation: Run driver.ps1 -SelfTest immediately after relocation in canary environment; if failures occur, analyze variable scope and add necessary imports or refactor guard to use file 86's context

risks.risk: Removing the guard from file 85 creates a gap in loop-mode-transitions logic that affects other workflows
risks.mitigation: Audit all callers and dependencies of file 85; if the guard serves dual purposes, consider leaving a forwarding call or refactoring the dependency

risks.risk: Canary deployment fails due to environmental differences between canary and production
risks.mitigation: Ensure canary environment mirrors production configuration; run full smoke.ps1 suite; have rollback notes ready for immediate reversion

risks.risk: Operator authorization is delayed or denied, blocking the deployment
risks.mitigation: Prepare clear evidence package (canary results, test outputs, risk analysis) to expedite approval; escalate through management if necessary
